purpose: Repeat only the controller B-edge mapping after correcting the tick-0 sample-age timestamp ordering that halted attempt 1 before operator action.

fix_contract.change: Compute controller sample age using clock_ns sampled after controller.read_into, matching runtime and main-probe ordering.

operator_handshake.authorization_scope: controller-only; no serial, servo, torque, policy, or motion
operator_handshake.before_launch: Operator is physically present with the known-good controller connected and does not press A or B.
operator_handshake.operator_action: Press B exactly once after the GO cue and do not press A.
operator_handshake.timeout: If B is not observed within 3000 ticks, the replacement fails and is not retried under this preregistration.

stop_rules: Any source, attempt receipt, controller identity, or Bluetooth-state mismatch blocks before the probe starts.
Pressing A fails the replacement because A is pause/unpause, not emergency stop.
Controller disconnect or any sample age outside 0 through 250 ms fails the replacement.
No serial device, servo bus, torque command, policy, or motion path may be opened.
A pass authorizes only preparation of a separately preregistered suspended no-policy cutoff test; it does not authorize that test.
No grounded launcher or grounded motion may be prepared from a NOT_RUN or failed result.
required_authorization_text: I am physically present with the known-good Xbox controller connected. I authorize the frozen controller-only B-button emergency-stop mapping probe: at most 3000 controller ticks, no serial or servo access, no torque, no policy, and no motion. I will press B exactly once only after you say GO and will not press A.
advance: After a physical PASS_REVIEWED of this exact replacement, freeze a separate suspended, no-policy home-entry emergency-stop cutoff revalidation. Do not create a grounded execution path yet.
